[[File:Claudina.png|250px|thumb|Claudina]] '''Claudina''' (Japanese: '''トラミ''' ''Torami'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP002|Two Degrees of Separation!]]''. Claudina is a truck driver who met {{an|Brock}} in [[Pewter City]] when he was trying to hitch a ride to [[Sinnoh]]. She and Brock encountered {{Ash}} when he was traveling on {{rt|202|Sinnoh}}. Brock was attracted to her and was planning on traveling with her, but all of that changed when he found out she already had a boyfriend. She said goodbye to Brock, thanked him for the lunch and dinner he made for her, and drove off. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=佐藤智恵 ''[[Chie Satō]]'' |en=[[Emlyn McFarland|Emily Williams]] |cs=Klára Šumanová |fi=Jenni Sivonen |fr_eu=Fabienne Loriaux |no=Hanne Dancke Arnesen |pl=Anna Wodzyńska |pt_br=Elisa Villon |es_la=Angélica Villa |es_eu=Isatxa Mengíbar}} ==Trivia== * Her Japanese name is based on トラック ''truck''.
